description: Implementation of RAM-based memory buffer backing store for demand paging in Zephyr OS, including functions for managing backing store locations, page in/out, and initialization.

methods.name: location_to_slab
methods.description: Converts a memory location to a pointer within the backing store slab.

methods.name: slab_to_location
methods.description: Converts a slab pointer back to its corresponding memory location.

methods.name: k_mem_paging_backing_store_location_get
methods.description: Allocates a backing store location for a page, handling page faults and free slabs.

methods.name: k_mem_paging_backing_store_location_free
methods.description: Frees a backing store location when a page is no longer needed.

methods.name: k_mem_paging_backing_store_page_out
methods.description: Copies page data out to the backing store.

methods.name: k_mem_paging_backing_store_page_in
methods.description: Copies page data into memory from the backing store.

methods.name: k_mem_paging_backing_store_page_finalize
methods.description: Finalizes a page by freeing its backing store location.

methods.name: k_mem_paging_backing_store_init
methods.description: Initializes the backing store and slabs.
